newsitem.title: ZAIRE: Zaire's rebel leader arrives in Kisangani.
newsitem.headline: Zaire's rebel leader arrives in Kisangani.

text.p: Zairean rebel leader Laurent Kabila arrived in the northeastern capital of Kisangani on Friday and was greeted as a liberator by more than 10,000 people, witnesses said.
Asked by reporters in Kisangani whether he could accept a ceasefire as called for by ailing Zairean President Mobutu Sese Seko, Kabila told reporters: "We negotiate first."
It was Kabila's first visit to Kisangani since it fell to rebel forces last Saturday. He flew in from the eastern city of Goma.
Crowds sang Christian hymns as Kabila arrived. One fervent supporter carried a placard proclaiming Kabila as God's servant: "It is God who has sent Kabila to come down and be amongst us."
"We are waiting for Kabila. He is our Moses," said Alpha Kangudi, a 23-year-old student.
